requirement: Return one criterion as a read-only projection: its id, name, the human-readable formula string, and the structured formula DTO; a missing id is reported as ResourceNotFound and a mapper failure is propagated.

preconditions.text: The requested criterion exists and is live
The stored formula is one of the shapes the formula mapper understands
The requested id matches no live criterion

inputs.text: Query for one of two criteria that share a name
Query for a bare boolean constant criterion
Query for a criterion that was soft deleted beforehand
Query whose formula mapper reports a failure
Query for the nested CURB-65 formula (AGE >= 65) AND (SBP < 90)
Query for a comparison criterion with both formula representations

returns.text: Success with the criterion id, name, and rendered formula string
The structured formula DTO mirrors the stored tree and carries only the fields of its shape
Only non-leaf operands are parenthesised in the rendered string
Failure with ResourceNotFound and a null payload
Failure propagated unchanged from the formula mapper

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing criterion or failing mapper is returned as a failed Result
